responsibility: Implements the `a <: b` relation for inference by instantiating unresolved type variables with variance-aware generalized values, recording deferred subtype obligations when both sides are still variables, translating region subtyping into region constraints, and handling higher-ranked binders and local opaque types during subtyping. It also handles subtyping relations where one side is a local opaque type such as `impl Trait`: it generalizes the non-opaque side before calling opaque-type handling, records the resulting obligations, and on opaque-type relation errors maps generalized `TypeError::Sorts` values back to the original expected and found types so fresh variables created only for this relation do not leak out of the subtyping check.
